node.title: Re: SOS: Ability to GET got BOMed
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Based on the timing, I figured installing File::BOM somehow damaged the files of WWW::Mechanize

If the files got "damaged" then I think you'd be seeing some more serious error messages from scripts using [mod://WWW::Mechanize]. If [mod://WWW::Mechanize] optionally used [mod://File::BOM] if it is installed, then that might possibly make sense. However, if I am understanding correctly, then you couldn't even get [mod://File::BOM] installed in the first place? Even if you did, [mod://File::BOM] [http://search.cpan.org/grep?cpanid=OALDERS&release=WWW-Mechanize-1.86&string=BOM&i=1&n=1&C=1|isn't mentioned anywhere] in the [mod://WWW::Mechanize] source or the [http://deps.cpantesters.org/?module=WWW%3A%3AMechanize;perl=latest|dependency tree]. So overall I have to doubt whether simply installing (or trying to install) [mod://File::BOM] would cause [mod://WWW::Mechanize] to stop downloading files...

So I would suggest you debug the two problems separately: Why can't you get new modules installed, and why did your [mod://WWW::Mechanize] stop working.

It looks like your [mod://cpan] is malfunctioning, at various places you're getting error messages like "Couldn't move C:\strawberry\cpan\build\tmp-3808\ExtUtils-MakeMaker-7.30\lib to C:\strawberry\cpan\build\ExtUtils-MakeMaker-7.30-pzCWn3\lib: No such file or directory at C:\strawberry\perl\lib/CPAN/Distribution.pm line 516". This is quite strange. I'm not an expert at debugging the cpan client on Windows, so instead of suggesting things to try, which might muck stuff up even more, perhaps for now as a first step you can just switch CPAN clients - give [mod://App::cpanminus] a try, cpanm should already come with Strawberry Perl.

As for [mod://WWW::Mechanize], it looks like you're checking for errors - are you getting any? Try removing the eval, since at this stage you're interested in seeing any error messages that may show up. Have you tried setting up a small script ([id://1177642]) that just downloads one file, to see if it still works in general? If not, post the code that doesn't work here.
